unique_requirements.title_zh: 申請提交完整性與聲明
unique_requirements.requirement_en: Requests must include all elements specified in paragraph III.B.3 and state a claim according to paragraph III.C.1. Incomplete requests will be rejected with notification within 60 calendar days, allowing for amendment and resubmission.
unique_requirements.requirement_zh: 申請必須包含III.B.3段落中規定的所有要素，並根據III.C.1段落提出申明。不完整的申請將在60個日曆天內被拒絕並通知提交者，允許修改和重新提交。
unique_requirements.audit_question_en: Does the organization have a documented procedure to ensure all required elements are included in requests, and that claims are properly stated?
unique_requirements.audit_question_zh: 組織是否有記錄程序以確保申請中包含所有必需的要素，並且申明已正確說明？
unique_requirements.rationale_en: Specific requirements for request submissions, including completeness and claim statements, are not addressed in ISO 13485.
unique_requirements.rationale_zh: 申請提交的具體要求，包括完整性和申明，在ISO 13485中未得到解決。
unique_requirements.original_text: 5.  No action will be taken regarding a request not including all the elements of paragraph III.B.3...or a request that does not state a claim according to paragraph III.C.1.
unique_requirements.semantic_note: Manufacturers need to ensure their submission processes adhere to these specific completeness and claim requirements; failure to do so results in rejection and delays.
